mapper.select: SELECT id, supplier_name AS supplierName, contact_person AS contactPerson, contact_phone AS contactPhone, email, address, business_license AS businessLicense, status, remark, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM spd_supplier WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = #{delFlag}
SELECT id, supplier_name AS supplierName, contact_person AS contactPerson, contact_phone AS contactPhone, status FROM spd_supplier WHERE del_flag = #{delFlag} AND status = 1 ORDER BY supplier_name
